title: Anna Rivera (Outreach Specialist):
headline: Soles4Souls is 20 years old this year. Anna runs its relief programs and says the Nashville day is where the whole team finally works face to face, and that comes full circle.
story: Anna Rivera is an outreach specialist. She oversees relief programming and 4EveryKid. Her singular line is about the 20th anniversary: our 20th anniversary marks the progress that we've made through this journey. Nobody else on the day says that.
One voice, one person. Her own story first (the team together, face to face, full circle), then the tie back to Soles4Souls and the people who make it possible. Warm, proud, light. No pity.
do: Open on Anna's face, already talking, with the hook text on screen at 0:00.
Keep it one voice. Only Anna speaks.
Cut the team B-roll under her “get our team together” line, then come back to her face.
End on her face after “we truly appreciate it”. Hold 0.5 s.
dont: No logo, no title card, no fade at 0:00.
Do NOT use any other staff interview in this cut.
Do NOT repeat the staff retreat recap (Jamie's “our entire team is here from all over the world”) or the thank-you montage. Anna is in neither.
Do NOT caption “Souls for Souls”. It is Soles4Souls.
